timeline.text: Welcome to Reset After a Hard Day. I’ll guide you through each tapping point. At every point, you’ll hear a short phrase. Repeat it aloud, or quietly inside your head. Let’s begin.

timeline.ins: Begin tapping on the side of your hand.
timeline.say: Today was harder than I wanted it to be.

timeline.ins: Now tap the top of your head.
timeline.say: I am still carrying what happened.

timeline.ins: Move to the beginning of your eyebrows.
timeline.say: Part of me keeps replaying the day.

timeline.ins: Now tap at the side of your eyes.
timeline.say: I wish I had handled some things differently.

timeline.ins: Move under your eyes.
timeline.say: My body is holding all this tension.

timeline.ins: Now tap under your nose.
timeline.say: I feel tired and frustrated.

timeline.ins: Move to your chin.
timeline.say: I want the day to feel finished.

timeline.ins: Now tap your collarbones.
timeline.say: I can admit this took a lot out of me.

timeline.ins: Finish this round under your arm.
timeline.say: I have been holding on for hours.

timeline.text: Take one easy breath. Notice whether anything has shifted, even slightly. If nothing has changed yet, that’s completely okay. Keep breathing, and we’ll continue.

timeline.ins: Return to the side of your hand.
timeline.say: I can let this day be imperfect.

timeline.ins: Tap the top of your head.
timeline.say: I do not need to solve it all tonight.

timeline.ins: Move to the beginning of your eyebrows.
timeline.say: I can learn without punishing myself.

timeline.ins: Tap at the side of your eyes.
timeline.say: I can let the replay slow down.

timeline.ins: Move under your eyes.
timeline.say: My body is allowed to release.

timeline.ins: Tap under your nose.
timeline.say: Rest is not something I have to earn.

timeline.ins: Move to your chin.
timeline.say: Tomorrow can hold what is not finished.

timeline.ins: Tap your collarbones.
timeline.say: I can offer myself some compassion.

timeline.ins: Finish this round under your arm.
timeline.say: I can loosen my grip on today.

timeline.text: Take another slow breath. Notice what feels different now. You do not need the feeling to disappear. See if there is simply a little less pressure, or a little more choice in how you meet this moment.

timeline.ins: Return to the side of your hand.
timeline.say: I am allowed to begin again.

timeline.ins: Tap the top of your head.
timeline.say: I can carry the lesson without carrying the weight.

timeline.ins: Move to the beginning of your eyebrows.
timeline.say: I choose to be on my own side.

timeline.ins: Tap at the side of your eyes.
timeline.say: I can return to the present moment.

timeline.ins: Move under your eyes.
timeline.say: My body knows how to settle.

timeline.ins: Tap under your nose.
timeline.say: I am worthy of a peaceful evening.

timeline.ins: Move to your chin.
timeline.say: This day does not define me.

timeline.ins: Tap your collarbones.
timeline.say: I can make room for something gentler now.

timeline.ins: Finish under your arm.
timeline.say: I am ready to move forward.

timeline.text: Let your hands rest, and take one full breath. Notice how you feel now, without needing to judge it. Thank you for taking this time for yourself. Carry this steadiness with you as you continue.
